"""Custom scraper for Cambridge Public Library events"""
import logging
import re
from datetime import datetime
from typing import List, Optional
from dateutil import parser as date_parser

from src.scrapers.base_scraper import BaseScraper
from src.models.event import EventCreate, EventCategory

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class CambridgePublicLibraryScraper(BaseScraper):
    """Custom scraper for Cambridge Public Library events"""

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__(
            source_name="Cambridge Public Library",
            source_url="https://www.cambridgepubliclibrary.org/events",
            use_selenium=False
        )

    def fetch_event_details(self, event_url: str) -> tuple:
        """Fetch full description and image from event detail page
        Returns (description, image_url)
        """
        try:
            full_url = event_url if event_url.startswith('http') else f"https://www.cambridgepubliclibrary.org{event_url}"
            html = self.fetch_html(full_url)
            soup = self.parse_html(html)

            description = ""
            image_url = None

            # Extract image
            image_url = self.extract_image_url(soup, full_url)

            # Extract description from event detail page
            desc_div = soup.find('div', class_=re.compile(r'event.*description|description', re.I))
            if desc_div:
                paragraphs = desc_div.find_all('p')
                desc_parts = []
                for p in paragraphs:
                    text = self.clean_text(p.get_text())
                    if len(text) > 10:
                        desc_parts.append(text)
                if desc_parts:
                    description = ' '.join(desc_parts)[:2000]

            # If no description div, try other common containers
            if not description:
                content_div = soup.find('div', class_=re.compile(r'content|body|details', re.I))
                if content_div:
                    text = self.clean_text(content_div.get_text())
                    if len(text) > 20:
                        description = text[:2000]

            return description, image_url

        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning(f"Failed to fetch event details from {event_url}: {str(e)}")
            return "", None

    def parse_event_datetime(self, date_text: str, time_text: str = None) -> Optional[datetime]:
        """Parse event date and time strings into datetime object"""
        try:
            # Clean up the text
            date_text = self.clean_text(date_text)
            
            # If time is provided separately, combine them
            if time_text:
                time_text = self.clean_text(time_text)
                datetime_str = f"{date_text} {time_text}"
            else:
                datetime_str = date_text

            # Use dateutil parser which handles various formats
            parsed_date = date_parser.parse(datetime_str, fuzzy=True)
            
            # If no year is specified, dateutil might default to current year
            # Check if the date is in the past and add a year if needed
            current_year = datetime.now().year
            if parsed_date.year < current_year or (parsed_date.year == current_year and parsed_date < datetime.now()):
                # Try parsing with explicit year
                datetime_str_with_year = f"{date_text} {current_year + 1}"
                if time_text:
                    datetime_str_with_year += f" {time_text}"
                try:
                    parsed_date = date_parser.parse(datetime_str_with_year, fuzzy=True)
                except:
                    pass
            
            return parsed_date

        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning(f"Failed to parse datetime from '{date_text}' and '{time_text}': {str(e)}")
            return None

    def extract_location_info(self, location_text: str) -> dict:
        """Extract venue name and address from location text"""
        location_info = {
            'venue_name': 'Cambridge Public Library',
            'street_address': None,
            'city': 'Cambridge',
            'state': 'MA',
            'zip_code': None
        }

        if not location_text:
            return location_info

        location_lower = location_text.lower()

        # Check for specific library branches
        if 'main library' in location_lower or '449 broadway' in location_lower:
            location_info['venue_name'] = 'Cambridge Public Library - Main Library'
            location_info['street_address'] = '449 Broadway'
            location_info['zip_code'] = '02138'
        elif 'central square' in location_lower or '45 pearl' in location_lower:
            location_info['venue_name'] = 'Cambridge Public Library - Central Square Branch'
            location_info['street_address'] = '45 Pearl Street'
            location_info['zip_code'] = '02139'
        elif 'boudreau' in location_lower or '245 concord' in location_lower:
            location_info['venue_name'] = 'Cambridge Public Library - Boudreau Branch'
            location_info['street_address'] = '245 Concord Avenue'
            location_info['zip_code'] = '02138'
        elif 'collins' in location_lower or '64 aberdeen' in location_lower:
            location_info['venue_name'] = 'Cambridge Public Library - Collins Branch'
            location_info['street_address'] = '64 Aberdeen Avenue'
            location_info['zip_code'] = '02138'
        elif 'o\'neill' in location_lower or 'oneill' in location_lower or '70 rindge' in location_lower:
            location_info['venue_name'] = 'Cambridge Public Library - O\'Neill Branch'
            location_info['street_address'] = '70 Rindge Avenue'
            location_info['zip_code'] = '02140'
        elif 'valente' in location_lower or '826 cambridge' in location_lower:
            location_info['venue_name'] = 'Cambridge Public Library - Valente Branch'
            location_info['street_address'] = '826 Cambridge Street'
            location_info['zip_code'] = '02141'
        elif 'online' in location_lower or 'virtual' in location_lower or 'zoom' in location_lower:
            location_info['venue_name'] = 'Cambridge Public Library - Online'

        return location_info

    def categorize_event(self, title: str, description: str) -> EventCategory:
        """Categorize event based on keywords"""
        text = f"{title} {description}".lower()

        if any(word in text for word in ['book', 'reading', 'author', 'literature', 'poetry', 'story']):
            return EventCategory.LECTURES
        elif any(word in text for word in ['music', 'concert', 'jazz', 'folk', 'classical', 'band']):
            return EventCategory.MUSIC
        elif any(word in text for word in ['art', 'craft', 'painting', 'drawing', 'exhibition', 'gallery']):
            return EventCategory.ARTS_CULTURE
        elif any(word in text for word in ['film', 'movie', 'cinema', 'screening']):
            return EventCategory.ARTS_CULTURE
        elif any(word in text for word in ['lecture', 'talk', 'discussion', 'seminar', 'workshop']):
            return EventCategory.LECTURES
        elif any(word in text for word in ['theater', 'theatre', 'play', 'performance', 'drama']):
            return EventCategory.THEATER
        elif any(word in text for word in ['kids', 'children', 'family', 'toddler', 'baby', 'youth']):
            return EventCategory.COMMUNITY
        else:
            return EventCategory.COMMUNITY

    def scrape_events(self) -> List[EventCreate]:
        """Scrape events from Cambridge Public Library"""
        events = []
        
        try:
            html = self.fetch_html(self.source_url)
            soup = self.parse_html(html)

            # Find event containers - try multiple selectors
            event_containers = []
            
            # Try different container patterns
            event_containers.extend(soup.find_all('li', class_=re.compile(r'event', re.I)))
            event_containers.extend(soup.find_all('div', class_=re.compile(r'event', re.I)))
            event_containers.extend(soup.find_all('article', class_=re.compile(r'event', re.I)))

            # If no events found with class, try data attributes
            if not event_containers:
                event_containers = soup.find_all(['div', 'li', 'article'], attrs={'data-event': True})

            logger.info(f"Found {len(event_containers)} potential event containers")

            for container in event_containers[:50]:  # Limit to 50 events
                try:
                    # Extract title
                    title_elem = container.find(['h2', 'h3', 'h4', 'a'], class_=re.compile(r'title|name|heading', re.I))
                    if not title_elem:
                        title_elem = container.find(['h2', 'h3', 'h4'])
                    if not title_elem:
                        title_elem = container.find('a')
                    
                    if not title_elem:
                        continue

                    title = self.clean_text(title_elem.get_text())
                    if not title or len(title) < 3:
                        continue

                    # Extract event URL
                    event_url = None
                    link_elem = container.find('a', href=True)
                    if link_elem:
                        event_url = link_elem.get('href')
                        if event_url and not event_url.startswith('http'):
                            event_url = f"https://www.cambridgepubliclibrary.org{event_url}"

                    # Extract date
                    date_elem = container.find(['time', 'span', 'div'], class_=re.compile(r'date', re.I))
                    if not date_elem:
                        date_elem = container.find('time')
                    
                    date_text = None
                    if date_elem:
                        date_text = self.clean_text(date_elem.get_text())
                        # Also check for datetime attribute
                        if not date_text and date_elem.get('datetime'):
                            date_text = date_elem.get('datetime')

                    # Extract time
                    time_elem = container.find(['span', 'div'], class_=re.compile(r'time', re.I))
                    time_text = self.clean_text(time_elem.get_text()) if time_elem else None

                    # Parse datetime
                    start_datetime = None
                    if date_text:
                        start_datetime = self.parse_event_datetime(date_text, time_text)
                    
                    if not start_datetime:
                        # Try to find any date-like text in the container
                        full_text = self.clean_text(container.get_text())
                        date_match = re.search(r'(January|February|March|April|May|June|July|August|September|October|November|December)\s+\d{1,2}(?:,\s*\d{4})?', full_text, re.I)
                        if date_match:
                            start_datetime = self.parse_event_datetime(date_match.group())
                    
                    if not start_datetime:
                        continue

                    # Extract location
                    location_elem = container.find(['span', 'div'], class_=re.compile(r'location|venue', re.I))
                    location_text = self.clean_text(location_elem.get_text()) if location_elem else ""
                    location_info = self.extract_location_info(location_text)

                    # Extract brief description from container
                    desc_elem = container.find(['p', 'div'], class_=re.compile(r'description|summary|excerpt', re.I))
                    brief_description = self.clean_text(desc_elem.get_text()) if desc_elem else ""

                    # Fetch full details from event page if URL available
                    full_description = brief_description
                    image_url = None
                    if event_url:
                        detailed_desc, img_url = self.fetch_event_details(event_url)
                        if detailed_desc:
                            full_description = detailed_desc
                        if img_url:
                            image_url = img_url

                    # Use title as description fallback
                    if not full_description or len(full_description) < 20:
                        full_description = f"{title} at {location_info['venue_name']}"

                    # Determine if family friendly
                    family_friendly = any(keyword in title.lower() or keyword in full_description.lower() 
                                        for keyword in ['children', 'kids', 'family', 'toddler', 'baby', 'youth', 'teen'])

                    # Categorize event
                    category = self.categorize_event(title, full_description)

                    # Extract age restrictions if present
                    age_restrictions = None
                    age_match = re.search(r'(?:ages?|for)\s+(\d+(?:\s*-\s*\d+)?(?:\s*(?:and|&|\+)\s*(?:up|older))?)', 
                                        full_description, re.I)
                    if age_match:
                        age_restrictions = age_match.group(1)

                    # Check for registration requirement
                    registration_required = any(keyword in full_description.lower() 
                                              for keyword in ['registration required', 'register', 'sign up', 'rsvp'])

                    event = EventCreate(
                        title=title[:200],
                        description=full_description[:2000],
                        start_datetime=start_datetime,
                        source_url=event_url or self.source_url,
                        source_name=self.source_name,
                        venue_name=location_info['venue_name'],
                        street_address=location_info['street_address'],
                        city=location_info['city'],
                        state=location_info['state'],
                        zip_code=location_info['zip_code'],
                        category=category,
                        family_friendly=family_friendly,
                        age_restrictions=age_restrictions,
                        registration_required=registration_required,
                        cost='Free',  # Library events are typically free
                        image_url=image_url
                    )
                    events.append(event)

                except Exception as e:
                    logger.warning(f"Failed to parse event: {str(e)}")
                    continue

        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Failed to scrape Cambridge Public Library events: {str(e)}")
            raise

        return events

"""Scraper for Museum of Science Boston events"""
import logging
from datetime import datetime
from typing import List, Optional
import requests
from dateutil import parser as dateparse
from src.scrapers.base_scraper import BaseScraper
from src.models.event import EventCreate, EventCategory

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class MuseumOfScienceScraper(BaseScraper):
    """Scrape events from Museum of Science Boston"""

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__(
            source_name="Museum of Science",
            source_url="https://www.mos.org/events",
            use_selenium=False,
        )

    def scrape_events(self) -> List[EventCreate]:
        """Fetch events from the Museum of Science API"""
        events = []
        
        api_url = "https://www.mos.org/api/v1/event-listing/event_detail/96+101/all/all/all"
        params = {
            "items_per_page": 100,
            "sort_by": "date_asc"
        }
        
        try:
            response = requests.get(
                api_url,
                params=params,
                headers=self.get_browser_headers(),
                timeout=30,
            )
            response.raise_for_status()
            data = response.json()
            
            event_items = data.get("events", [])
            if not event_items:
                logger.warning("No events found in API response")
                return events
            
            for item in event_items:
                try:
                    event = self._parse_event(item)
                    if event:
                        events.append(event)
                except Exception as e:
                    logger.warning(f"Failed to parse event: {e}")
                    continue
            
            logger.info(f"Successfully parsed {len(events)} events from Museum of Science")
            
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Failed to fetch events from Museum of Science API: {e}")
            raise
        
        return events

    def _parse_event(self, item: dict) -> Optional[EventCreate]:
        """Parse a single event from the API response"""
        
        title = item.get("title", "").strip()
        if not title:
            return None
        
        description_html = item.get("description", "")
        if description_html:
            from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
            soup = BeautifulSoup(description_html, 'html.parser')
            description = self.clean_text(soup.get_text())
        else:
            description = title
        
        if not description:
            description = title
        
        date_str = item.get("date")
        if not date_str:
            return None
        
        try:
            start_datetime = dateparse.parse(date_str)
        except (ValueError, TypeError) as e:
            logger.warning(f"Could not parse date '{date_str}': {e}")
            return None
        
        end_date_str = item.get("end_date")
        end_datetime = None
        if end_date_str:
            try:
                end_datetime = dateparse.parse(end_date_str)
            except (ValueError, TypeError):
                pass
        
        event_path = item.get("path", "")
        if event_path:
            if event_path.startswith("http"):
                event_url = event_path
            else:
                event_url = f"https://www.mos.org{event_path}"
        else:
            event_url = self.source_url
        
        image_url = item.get("image")
        if image_url and not image_url.startswith("http"):
            image_url = f"https://www.mos.org{image_url}"
        
        location = item.get("location", "").strip()
        venue_name = location if location else "Museum of Science"
        
        event_type = item.get("event_type", "").strip()
        
        category = EventCategory.OTHER
        event_type_lower = event_type.lower() if event_type else ""
        title_lower = title.lower()
        desc_lower = description.lower()
        
        if any(word in event_type_lower or word in title_lower for word in ["science", "exhibit", "planetarium", "theater", "show"]):
            category = EventCategory.ARTS_CULTURE
        elif any(word in event_type_lower or word in title_lower for word in ["lecture", "talk", "presentation"]):
            category = EventCategory.LECTURES
        elif any(word in event_type_lower or word in title_lower for word in ["community", "family"]):
            category = EventCategory.COMMUNITY
        
        family_friendly = True
        age_restrictions = item.get("age_restrictions")
        
        cost = item.get("cost", "").strip()
        if not cost:
            cost = "Museum admission required"
        
        registration_required = bool(item.get("registration_required", False))
        
        tags = []
        if event_type:
            tags.append(event_type)
        
        topics = item.get("topics", [])
        if topics:
            if isinstance(topics, list):
                tags.extend([t.strip() for t in topics if t])
            elif isinstance(topics, str):
                tags.append(topics.strip())
        
        tags = [tag for tag in tags if tag][:10]
        
        return EventCreate(
            title=title[:200],
            description=description[:2000],
            start_datetime=start_datetime,
            end_datetime=end_datetime,
            source_url=event_url,
            source_name=self.source_name,
            venue_name=venue_name[:150] if venue_name else "Museum of Science",
            city="Boston",
            state="MA",
            category=category,
            tags=tags,
            family_friendly=family_friendly,
            age_restrictions=age_restrictions,
            cost=cost,
            registration_required=registration_required,
            image_url=image_url,
        )
